classes.name: Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs)
classes.description: Direct oral anticoagulants (apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, edoxaban) — first-line therapy for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation and treatment/prevention of venous thromboembolism, largely supplanting warfarin.
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill that prevents dangerous blood clots and stroke.
classes.indication: Atrial fibrillation & venous thromboembolism (DVT/PE) prevention and treatment
